# Benchmark results — vx vs Turborepo vs Nx vs Vite Task

<!-- Generated by `bun packages/vx-bench/compare.ts`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Workspace:** 1,601 projects, 9,603 tasks: 29 levels × 50 libs and 100 apps, 50 terminal libs at level 15, one `e2e` on every edge, five core libs ~400 projects each use (packages/vx-bench/shape.ts).
- **Tasks:** `installDeps` (^build, no command), `build`, `lint`, `test` (after installDeps), `publish` (after build), `typecheck` (^build). Each sleeps: build 1000 ms, lint 250 ms, test 500 ms, publish 100 ms, typecheck 500 ms. `build` writes dist/index.js from 20 source files and 200 KB of seeded incompressible bytes. Identical commands in every runner.
- **Concurrency:** 10 for every runner. **Reps:** cold 1, core edit 1, the rest median of 3.
- **vx:** compiled binary from a `vx lock` snapshot (`--frozen`); `vx (no lock)` evaluates every config per run.
- **Host:** Linux 6.18.44-fc-v80 · 4 cores · linux/x64
- **Date:** 2026-10-09

## Wall time (warm, restore, edits)

| Runner       | Warm    | Restore | Leaf edited | Core edited | CPU, cold | CPU, warm |
| ------------ | ------- | ------- | ----------- | ----------- | --------- | --------- |
| ideal        | 59 ms   | 408 ms  | 1.56 s      | 5m 50s      | 27.74 s   | 97 ms     |
| vx           | 1.02 s  | 2.10 s  | 2.46 s      | 5m 57s      | 1m 14s    | 1.95 s    |
| vx (no lock) | 1.04 s  | 2.19 s  | 2.62 s      | 5m 58s      | 1m 14s    | 1.98 s    |
| turbo        | 1.11 s  | 2.17 s  | 2.34 s      | 5m 59s      | 1m 38s    | 2.37 s    |
| nx           | 26.02 s | 25.62 s | 28.56 s     | 7m 6s       | 6m 41s    | 32.75 s   |
| vite-task    | 12.30 s | 12.38 s | 12.18 s     | 5m 56s      | 58.34 s   | 12.18 s   |

**Ideal** is the theoretical best case: cold is the tasks' own durations
list-scheduled critical-path first on 10 workers (critical path
30.50 s, work ÷ workers 6m 16s); warm is one
`git status -uall` walk, the floor of asking what changed; restore adds a raw
copy of every output; an edit is that walk plus the ideal schedule of the
tasks it re-runs (leaf: 8 tasks, core: 8,912).
CPU is user + system of the invocation and the children it waited for; a
daemon that outlives the invocation (Turbo's, Nx's) is not counted.

Reproduce: `bun packages/vx-bench/compare.ts 3`.
